RunFullTrustJustification: LiteSic is a native C++ Win32 desktop music player. It needs its existing desktop process to display Win32/Direct2D windows, read audio files selected by the user, decode and play audio through Windows audio APIs, and save per-user preferences and playlists. It does not require elevation, install services or drivers, collect telemetry, show ads or provide purchases. No account or network connection is required for local playback.
CertificationNotes: No sign-in is required. No music is bundled. To test, add your own MP3/WAV/FLAC/OGG files using the playlist Add > Files or Folder command, select a track and press Play. Verify pause, seek, volume, next/previous, shuffle/repeat, favorites and the equalizer. Close and reopen to test settings and playlist persistence. The Store profile uses the package LocalState directory. The Windows 7 compatibility goal applies to the separate traditional distribution, not this MSIX package.
